_comment: ball_px is a ball's diameter in the WARPED top-down view, which is table length in mm times 0.5. For an 8ft table that is 57.15 * 0.5 = 28.6 px, so raise min_fill and lower ball_px if blobs are being rejected. Switch to YOLO with {"detector": "yolo", "weights": "best.pt"}.
_ball_set: english switches the colour model to red/yellow/black/white and turns off stripe detection, which is both simpler and more reliable than the 7-hue American model.
